rules.description: PD makers must verify and obtain approval of their IFD upon receipt of digitally signed payment files.
rules.condition: On receipt of digitally signed payment files
rules.outcome: PD makers will verify and obtain approval of their IFD
rules.evidence_quote: On receipt of digitally signed payment files, PD makers will verify and obtain approval of their IFD.

rules.description: The same IFD approval number may be used for each payment file on NSP.
rules.condition: When referencing payment files on NSP
rules.outcome: The same IFD approval number can be mentioned against each payment file
rules.evidence_quote: The same IFD approval number can be mentioned against each payment file on NSP.

rules.description: All related activities must be completed by 20th November.
rules.condition: The deadline for completing the activities
rules.outcome: Activities will be completed by 20th November
rules.evidence_quote: These activities will be completed by 20th November,

rules.description: The concerned PD may obtain scheme-wise blanket IFD approval to reduce process time.
rules.condition: When seeking to reduce process time
rules.outcome: Scheme-wise blanket IFD approval is obtained
rules.evidence_quote: It is desirable that the concerned PD may obtain scheme-wise blanket IFD approval to reduce the process time.
